title: CPF Module Schema: CosmosDb Cassandra Table module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-cosmosdbcassandratable'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

analytical_storage_ttl.description: (Optional) Analytical storage TTL in seconds; null to omit.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

cassandra_keyspace_id.description: (Required) The Resource Id of the Cassandra Keyspace

cluster_keys.type: list(object({ name = optional(string, null), order_by = optional(string, "Asc") }))
cluster_keys.description: "(Optional) List of columns for a Cosmos DB Cassandra table. list(object({ name = (Optional) The name of the column as it will appear in the Cassandra table. This should follow Cassandra naming conventions—typically lowercase, using underscores for separation (e.g., `user_id`, `created_at`). It must be unique within the table and clearly represent the data it stores. order_by = (Optional) where order_by is Asc/Desc (any case). }))"

columns.description: "(Required) List of columns for a Cosmos DB Cassandra table. list(object({ name = (Required) The name of the column as it will appear in the Cassandra table. This should follow Cassandra naming conventions—typically lowercase, using underscores for separation (e.g., `user_id`, `created_at`). It must be unique within the table and clearly represent the data it stores. type = (Required) The data type of the column, compatible with Cassandra types such as `text`, `uuid`, `int`, `timestamp`, `boolean`, etc. }))"

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

default_ttl.description: (Optional) Default TTL in seconds; null to omit.

enable_table_autoscale_settings.description: (Optional) true => use autoscale_settings, false => use manual throughput.

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

id.description: The Resource Id of the cassandra table.

name.description: The name of the cassandra table.

resource.description: The Resource information of the cassandra table.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Cosmosdbcassandratable' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
